item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 17/Dec/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The weather will be cloudier over the coastal areas of Guangdong today and tomorrow. It will be cold this morning. A dry replenishment of the winter monsoon is expected to reach southern China midweek this week. The weather will improve and it will be cold in the morning over the region. With the monsoon persisting, it will still be dry over the coast of southern China and rather cool in the morning and at night in the latter part of this week. Besides, an area of low pressure to the east of the Philippines will bring unsettled weather to the region today and tomorrow.
